about: The mishearing skit as a radio play. Each line: who, voice, text, direction (how it is acted), gapBeforeMs (silence before it). OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts takes the direction as instructions.

lines.direction: Casual and a little distracted, talking to a smart speaker across the kitchen while cooking. Natural, unhurried.
A speech recognizer caught not listening, like an intern snapping back to attention. Quick, sheepish mumble.
Unsure, squinting, trying the word on. Rising, hesitant.
Trying the other option, slightly higher, still unsure.
A short beat, then overconfident and smug, fast, very sure of itself. Comic timing.
Flat, polite, bored customer-service tone. Says nothing about the amount.
Absent-minded, still cooking, not really listening.
